title: 第12章 御剑显神通，幻神瞳
slug: 刚成仙神子孙求我出山
content_zh:
妖道想开道观？
姜长生眼神冷下来，他觉得背后有人在推动，他立即跟随青苦前去。
与此同时，山门下，两方弟子正在对峙。
清虚道长、孟秋霜与一众弟子站在小桥前，而山门外同样有一群道士，为首的是一名中年道士，身躯消瘦，面容狡诈，他右手背于腰后，左手捏着山羊胡子，趾高气昂的盯着龙起观的道士们。
这位中年道士便是深得皇帝偏爱的妖道，自称还阳老仙，手下弟子十数位，大多都是来自京城的权贵子弟。
在他身旁还有一名少年，看起来十六七岁，身穿紫衣，衣着精美，头戴镶珠玉冠，面容俊朗，一看便知来历不凡。
清虚道长面无表情道：“道友，当真要逼死龙起观？”
在他身后有四位弟子被其他弟子搀扶着，这四位弟子身上都带着伤，惊怒交集的盯着中年道士。
还阳老仙笑道：“怎就要逼死呢，清虚道友，让出此山吧，你手底下的弟子都太弱了，贫道怀疑道友没有认真教导他们，既没有传武之心，何必霸占山头？”
此言一出，他的弟子们纷纷出言叫嚣，说得一个比一个难听。
“龙起观早就该拔了，不过是陛下念及旧情罢了。”
“是啊，龙起观对朝堂没有半点贡献，就连刚上任的武状元都背弃了龙起观。”
“我看呐，都是一群酒囊饭袋，没有半点儿能耐，连陛下都很少前来，还不如我们师父让位，让真正的仙师传道。”
“按照江湖规矩，你们若是不敌我们，就该让出，除非龙起观不以武林门派居之。”
“并非陛下食言，只是龙起观太废了，该当让位。”
面对叫嚣，龙起观弟子愤怒难耐，跟着还嘴，双方打起嘴炮。
还阳老仙抬手，身后的弟子们立即闭嘴。
见此，孟秋霜跟着让师弟师妹们停下来，再骂下去，有辱龙起观的形象。
还阳老仙笑呵呵道：“道友可要出手？你若能击败贫道，贫道立即下山，但若是道友输了，江湖规矩，挪观吧。”
清虚道长叹息一声，正要开口，一道声音传来。

“不知切磋若是死人该怎么办？”
弟子们扭头看去，一见来人，皆是神情大振，面露兴奋之色，大师姐孟秋霜也露出笑容。
姜长生漫步而来，身后的青苦狐假虎威，怒视还阳老仙。
还阳老仙盯着姜长生，笑问道：“可是十四岁便击杀鬼目邪王的长生道士？杀气可真够重的。”
紫衣少年看向姜长生，表情戏谑，不知在想什么。
姜长生右手按在太行剑的剑柄上，左手斜握着麒麟拂尘，他轻笑道：“江湖规矩，武夫切磋，生死由命，不是吗？”
还阳老仙的真气也就比鬼目邪王强一点，这两人若是死斗，鬼目邪王未必会输。
不过清虚道长自从中毒后，真气一直在溃散，已然不是还阳老仙的对手。
还阳老仙看不透姜长生的强弱，他甚至觉得姜长生是普通人，可击杀鬼目邪王的战绩摆在那儿。
就在还阳老仙犹豫时，他的弟子们开始怂恿，这些弟子都是纨绔子弟，拜他为师，除了盲目的崇拜外，也有的是被家中长辈所安排，所以根本不在意他的死活。
姜长生戏谑的盯着还阳老仙，根本不急。
这下子轮到还阳老仙骑虎难下。
还阳老仙看似桀骜自负，实则很谨慎，否则也不可能成为皇帝眼前的红人。
“既然不敢，那就滚吧！”
青苦忍不住喝骂道，其他弟子跟着嘲讽。
他们对姜长生充满信心，毕竟他们可是目睹不可一世的鬼目邪王被姜长生一脚踢死，至今记忆犹新。
还阳老仙露出笑容，道：“京城重地，岂能论生死，贫道若是杀了道友，那可不好办，罢了，下次再来。”
说罢，他抬手，准备叫弟子们撤离。
姜长生的右手放开剑柄，冷笑道：“龙起观岂是你想来就来的？”
话音落下，太行剑猛地出鞘，剑光闪耀，晃得所有人下意识闭目，还阳老仙同样如此，他跟着感受到刺痛，吓得睁开眼睛。

其他人只听到剑刃穿透血肉的声音，他们睁眼一看，只见还阳老仙半跪在地上，姜长生依旧站在原地，好像没有出手，但他腰间的太行剑不见了。
龙起观弟子们个个目瞪口呆，露出难以置信之色，连清虚道长也动容。
破空声跟着传来，太行剑从还阳老仙头顶掠过，削断一缕长发，自主地飞入姜长生腰上的剑鞘。
龙起观寂静！
所有人都惊呆了，连那位紫衣少年也动容，呆呆的望着姜长生。
这是什么武学？
还阳老仙瞪大眼睛，盯着姜长生，双目充血，额头上溢出豆大的冷汗，刚才他感受到了死亡的气息，这种感觉令他想到景朝立国前的乱世，曾经有一名贼将想要斩首他，那时，刀刃距离他的后颈不远，那股寒意与现在一模一样。
姜长生面无表情道：“以后别来沾边。”
太行剑洞穿了还阳老仙的肩膀，还斩断了部分经脉，导致他的真气溃散，没有一年半载很难恢复。
还阳老仙咬牙道：“扶我走！”
面对恐怖的姜绝世，他连一句狠话都不敢放。
弟子们连忙搀扶着他下山，个个狼狈至极，都被姜长生的御剑术吓破肝胆。
姜长生瞥向那位紫衣少年，此人身后还有四位守卫，一看身份就不简单，他犀利的目光将对方惊醒。
“大胆，休要对二殿下无礼！”
一名守卫怒声喝道，只是他的声音有些发抖。
姜长生的御剑术震碎了他的认知。
武学还能这样？
姜长生一听，朝紫衣少年抱拳，道：“二殿下想做客吗？”
与假太子争权的皇子。
姜长生听四皇子姜誉说过，二皇子姜明比太子小半年，其母乃是大景第一猛将洪烈之妹，在曹虎豹造反后，洪烈便成为三军主将，地位堪比二品重臣，甚至可以说一人之下万人之上。

洪烈自然是支持二皇子的，所以二皇子的派系也很强大，丝毫不弱于太子，他日皇位归谁，还不一定。
姜明目光灼灼的盯着姜长生，道：“长生道长真是厉害，刚才的剑术当真是……神奇，本殿下虽未闯荡过江湖，但也能看出长生道长的厉害，本殿下想邀请长生道长成为我的殿客，他日为你争取官位，享受大景俸禄，只要本殿下在，定保长生道长此生无忧，你想要什么，本殿下都尽力满足。”
此言一出，龙起观的弟子们都羡慕的看向姜长生。
之前已经有一位四皇子来拜师，如今二皇子也来了。
四皇子可不能与二皇子相比！
姜长生笑道：“多谢殿下赞赏，长生只想在这观里悟道，我最大的追求便是我的道号，世俗的荣华富贵与我无关。”
姜明上前，热情的握住姜长生的手，开始说各种漂亮话，他的话一听就是拍马屁，可他身份不同，说出来的效果不同。
姜长生礼貌性的回应，也不好直接薄了二太子的面子。
去年的文状元已经投效姜明，姜明手底下不缺文臣武将，但缺像姜长生这样的高手。
任凭他说得天花乱坠，姜长生还是婉拒，姜明遗憾，但并没有生气，而是向手下吩咐道：“从今日起，龙起观的长生道长便是本殿下的朋友，回去告诉还阳老仙，不得再来找麻烦，也告诉整个京城，谁敢招惹长生道长，便是不给本殿下面子。”
“是！”
四位守卫立即应下。
姜明对姜长生笑了笑，然后转身离去。
五人离去后，龙起观的弟子们立即围上来，个个兴奋至极。
清虚道长没有多说什么，转身离去。
孟秋霜走到姜长生跟前，道：“长生师弟，你又一次救了道观。”
姜长生笑道：“师姐说的什么话，我也是龙起观的一员，跟师姐平日里的忙碌相比，我算不得什么。”
孟秋霜露出赞许的笑容，她心中感慨万分，当初的小孩子如今已经撑起龙起观，时光真够快的。
应付完同门弟子后，姜长生迅速回到自己的房屋内。
【开元十七年，妖道还阳老仙来犯，你将其击退，你度过一场祸端，你获得生存奖励——法术‘幻神瞳’】

姜长生望着眼前的提示，心情美滋滋。
有人找茬其实也是好事，能让他不断变强。
随着他的灵力越来越多，与武者的差距越来越大，他感受到的压力远不如前，就算明日大军包围龙起观，他也不怕，只要施展御剑术，整个京城内谁能留住他？
传承完幻神瞳的记忆后，姜长生方才惊叹这幻神瞳很可怕啊。
幻神瞳练成后，只要与人对视，可更改他人记忆，这个过程会根据篡改记忆的信息量消耗灵力，对方还必须低于自己的修为，否则很容易看破，还对施术者造成反噬。
神技啊！
不过得练后才知道实用效果如何。
姜长生兴奋起来，开始修行幻神瞳。
接下来一个月，姜明派人来了五次，每次都带着厚礼来，有粮食、药材、书籍、玉石等，此事也在京城内传开。
姜长生知晓姜明的意思，这条船不上也得上！
可惜，他远远低估了姜长生。
对于这些厚礼，姜长生自然是收下，然后转赠给道观。
距离第五次送礼过去大半个月，姜长生得到一个惊人的消息。
姜明遭受刺杀，身受重伤！
content_en:
The demon wants to open a Taoist temple?
Jiang Changsheng's eyes turned cold. He felt someone pushing him from behind, and he immediately followed Qing Ku.
At the same time, under the mountain gate, the two disciples were confronting each other.
Taoist Master Qingxu, Meng Qiu Shuang and a group of disciples were standing in front of the small bridge. There was also a group of Taoist priests outside the mountain gate. The leader was a middle-aged Taoist priest with a thin body and a cunning face. He put his right hand behind his waist and held his goatee in his left hand. He stared at the Taoist priests at Longqi Temple with arrogance.
This middle-aged Taoist priest is the demon Taoist who is favored by the emperor. He calls himself Huanyang Laoxian and has more than ten disciples, most of whom are the children of powerful people from the capital.
There is a young man beside him, who looks to be sixteen or seventeen years old. He is dressed in purple and exquisitely dressed. He wears a jade crown with pearls on his head. He has a handsome face. He can tell at a glance that he has an extraordinary origin.
Taoist Master Qingxu said expressionlessly: "Fellow Taoist, do you really want to force Long Qiguan to death?"
Behind him were four disciples who were being supported by other disciples. These four disciples were all injured and stared at the middle-aged Taoist priest in shock and anger.
Old Immortal Huanyang said with a smile: "Why are you forced to death? Fellow Taoist Qingxu, please get out of this mountain. Your disciples are all too weak. I suspect that fellow Taoist has not taught them seriously and has no intention of spreading martial arts. Why occupy the top of the mountain?"
As soon as this statement came out, his disciples started shouting out words one after another, each one making them more irritating than the other.
"Long Qiguan should have been removed a long time ago, but His Majesty is just thinking about old feelings."
"Yes, Long Qiguan has not made any contribution to the court. Even the newly appointed Wu Zhuangyuan has turned his back on Long Qiguan."
"I see, they are all a bunch of drunkards. They don't have the slightest ability. Even His Majesty rarely comes here. It's better for our master to give up and let the real immortal master preach."
"According to the rules of the martial arts world, if you lose to us, you should give up, unless Long Qiguan is no longer a martial arts sect."
"It's not that His Majesty broke his promise, it's just that Long Qiguan is too useless and should give up his position."
Faced with the clamor, Long Qiguan's disciples became angry and retorted, and the two sides began to argue.
Old Immortal Huanyang raised his hand, and the disciples behind him immediately shut up.
Seeing this, Meng Qiu Shuang asked the junior brothers and sisters to stop. If he continued to scold, it would insult Long Qiguan's image.
Old Immortal Huanyang said with a smile: "Do you want to take action, fellow Taoist? If you can defeat Pindao, Pindao will come down the mountain immediately. But if fellow Taoist loses, it is a rule of the world, so stay away."
Taoist Priest Qingxu sighed and was about to speak when a voice came.
"I wonder what to do if someone dies during the sparring session?"
The disciples turned around and looked around. When they saw the visitor, they all became excited and excited. Senior Sister Meng Qiu Shuang also smiled.
Jiang Changsheng strolled over, the green bitter fox behind him pretending to be a tiger, glaring at Old Fairy Huanyang.
Old Immortal Huanyang stared at Jiang Changsheng and asked with a smile: "But the immortal Taoist priest who killed the Ghost Eye Evil King at the age of fourteen? His murderous intent is really strong."
The boy in purple clothes looked at Jiang Changsheng with a joking expression, wondering what he was thinking.
Jiang Changsheng placed his right hand on the hilt of the Taihang Sword, and held the Qilin Whisk at an angle in his left hand. He chuckled and said, "The rules of the martial arts world are that when martial artists compete, life and death are determined by fate, isn't it?"
Huanyang Laoxian's true energy is only slightly stronger than that of Ghost Eye Evil King. If these two people fight to the death, Ghost Eye Evil King may not lose.
However, since Taoist Priest Qingxu was poisoned, his true energy has been dissipating, and he is no longer a match for Old Immortal Huanyang.
Huanyang Laoxian couldn't see through Jiang Changsheng's strength. He even thought that Jiang Changsheng was an ordinary person, but his record of killing the Ghost Eye Evil King was there.
Just when Old Immortal Huanyang was hesitating, his disciples began to encourage him. These disciples were all playboys who worshiped him as their teacher. In addition to blind worship, some of them were arranged by their elders in the family, so they didn't care about his life or death at all.
Jiang Changsheng stared at Old Immortal Huanyang jokingly, not in a hurry at all.
Now it is the turn of Huanyang Lao Xian to ride on the tiger and be unable to get off.
Huanyang Laoxian seemed to be unruly and arrogant, but in fact he was very cautious, otherwise he would not have become a popular person in front of the emperor.
"If you don't dare, then get out!"
greenKu couldn't help but yelled and cursed, and the other disciples mocked him.
They had full confidence in Jiang Changsheng. After all, they had witnessed the arrogant Ghost-Eyed Evil King being kicked to death by Jiang Changsheng, and they still remembered it vividly.
Old Immortal Huanyang showed a smile and said: "How can we talk about life and death in this important place in the capital? If the poor Taoist kills fellow Taoist, it will not be easy. Let's just come back next time."
After saying that, he raised his hand and prepared to tell his disciples to evacuate.
Jiang Changsheng released his sword hilt with his right hand and sneered: "Did you come to Longqi Temple just when you wanted to?"
As soon as the words fell, the Taihang Sword was suddenly unsheathed, and the sword light shone brightly, causing everyone to subconsciously close their eyes. The same was true for Huanyang Laoxian. He then felt the sting and opened his eyes in fear.
The others only heard the sound of the sword penetrating flesh. When they opened their eyes, they saw Huanyang Old Immortal half-kneeling on the ground. Jiang Changsheng still stood there, as if he had not made any move, but the Taihang Sword around his waist was missing.
The disciples of Long Qiguan were all dumbfounded and looked in disbelief. Even Taoist Master Qingxu was moved.
The sound of breaking through the air followed, and the Taihang Sword passed over the head of Old Immortal Huanyang, cut off a strand of long hair, and flew autonomously into the scabbard on Jiang Changsheng's waist.
The dragon rises to observe the silence!
Everyone was stunned, even the young man in purple was moved, looking at Jiang Changsheng blankly.
What kind of martial arts is this?
Old Immortal Huanyang stared at Jiang Changsheng with wide eyes, bloodshot eyes, and a large amount of cold sweat on his forehead. He felt the breath of death just now. This feeling reminded him of the troubled times before the founding of the Jing Dynasty, when a thief general wanted to behead him. At that time, the blade was not far from the back of his neck, and the chill was exactly the same as now.
Jiang Changsheng said expressionlessly: "Don't get involved in this in the future."
The Taihang Sword pierced Old Immortal Huanyang's shoulder and severed part of his meridians, causing his true energy to collapse and it would be difficult to recover within a year and a half.
Huanyang Laoxian gritted his teeth and said, "Help me go!"
Facing the terrifying Jiang Jueshi, he didn't even dare to say a harsh word.
The disciples hurriedly helped him down the mountain. They were all extremely embarrassed, and they were all frightened to death by Jiang Changsheng's sword control skills.
Jiang Changsheng glanced at the young man in purple. There were four guards behind him. When he saw his identity, it was not easy. His sharp gaze woke him up.
"Be brave and don't be rude to His Highness!"
A guard shouted angrily, but his voice was trembling.
Jiang Changsheng's sword control skills shattered his cognition.
Can martial arts still be like this?
When Jiang Changsheng heard this, he clasped his fists towards the purple-clothed boy and said, "Your Highness, do you want to be a guest?"
The prince who competes with the fake prince for power.
Jiang Changsheng heard from the fourth prince Jiang Yu that the second prince Jiang Ming was half a year younger than the prince, and his mother was the sister of Hong Lie, the most powerful general in Da Jing. After Cao Hubao's rebellion, Hong Lie became the commander-in-chief of the three armies. His status was comparable to that of a second-rank minister. It could even be said that one person was inferior to ten thousand people.
Hong Lie naturally supports the second prince, so the second prince's faction is also very powerful, not weaker than the prince at all. It is not certain who will take the throne in the future.
Jiang Ming stared at Jiang Changsheng with burning eyes and said: "Taoist Changsheng is really powerful. The swordsmanship just now is really... magical. Although your highness has never been in the world, you can still see how powerful Taoist Changsheng is. I would like to invite Taoist Changsheng to be my guest. I will fight for you in the future and enjoy a great salary. As long as I am here, Taoist Changsheng will have no worries in your life. Whatever you want, I will do my best to satisfy you."
As soon as these words came out, the disciples of Long Qiguan all looked at Jiang Changsheng with envy.
A fourth prince had already come to be his disciple before, and now the second prince also came.
The fourth prince cannot be compared with the second prince!
Jiang Changsheng smiled and said: "Thank you for your compliments, Your Highness. Changsheng just wants to enlighten the Tao in this contemplation. My biggest pursuit is my Taoist name. Worldly glory and wealth have nothing to do with me."
Jiang Ming stepped forward, held Jiang Changsheng's hand enthusiastically, and began to say all kinds of beautiful words. His words sounded like flattery at first glance, but because of his different status, the effect of his words was different.
Jiang ChangshengA polite response would not directly hurt the Second Prince's face.
Last year's number one scholar, Wen, had joined Jiang Ming. Jiang Ming had no shortage of civil servants and generals, but he lacked masters like Jiang Changsheng.
No matter what he said, Jiang Changsheng declined politely. Jiang Ming regretted it, but was not angry. Instead, he ordered his subordinates: "From today on, the Taoist Changsheng of Longqiguan is a friend of His Highness. Go back and tell Old Immortal Huanyang not to cause trouble again, and tell the entire capital that anyone who dares to provoke Taoist Changsheng will not give face to my Highness."
"Yes!"
The four guards responded immediately.
Jiang Ming smiled at Jiang Changsheng, then turned and left.
After the five people left, the disciples of Long Qiguan immediately gathered around, and they were all extremely excited.
Taoist Master Qingxu didn't say anything more, turned around and left.
Meng Qiu Shuang walked up to Jiang Changsheng and said, "Junior Brother Changsheng, you saved the Taoist temple again."
Jiang Changsheng smiled and said: "Whatever Senior Sister said, I am also a member of Long Qiguan. Compared with Senior Sister's daily busyness, I am nothing."
Meng Qiu Shuang showed an approving smile, and she was filled with emotion. The child she was back then was now standing up to watch. Time flies so fast.
After dealing with his fellow disciples, Jiang Changsheng quickly returned to his house.
[In the seventeenth year of Kaiyuan, the demon Huanyang Old Immortal invaded. You repelled it, you survived the disaster, and you received the survival reward—the spell ‘Phantom God Pupil’]
Jiang Changsheng looked at the prompt in front of him and felt happy.
It's actually a good thing for someone to find trouble, as it can make him continue to get stronger.
As his spiritual power increases, the gap between him and the warriors becomes wider and wider, and the pressure he feels is far less than before. Even if the army surrounds Long Qiguan tomorrow, he is not afraid. As long as he uses sword control, who in the entire capital can keep him?
After inheriting the memory of the Phantom Divine Eye, Jiang Changsheng marveled at how terrifying the Phantom Divine Eye was.
After you have mastered the Magic Eye, you can change the memory of others as long as you look into someone's eyes. This process will consume spiritual power according to the amount of information that has been tampered with the memory. The other person must have a lower level of cultivation than yourself, otherwise it will be easy to see through it and cause backlash to the caster.
What a magical skill!
But you have to practice it before you know how effective it actually is.
Jiang Changsheng became excited and began to practice the Phantom Eyes.
In the next month, Jiang Ming sent people five times, each time bringing generous gifts, including food, medicinal materials, books, jade, etc. This matter also spread in the capital.
Jiang Changsheng knows what Jiang Ming means, and he has to get on this boat even if he doesn't!
Unfortunately, he underestimated Jiang Changsheng.
Jiang Changsheng naturally accepted these generous gifts and then gave them to the Taoist temple.
More than half a month had passed since the fifth gift was given, and Jiang Changsheng received shocking news.
Jiang Ming was assassinated and seriously injured!
